entries.answer:
Persze — ezt sokkal feszesebben, emberibben és végrehajthatóbban érdemes megírni. Az OpenAI képes útmutatói alapján a jobb képpromptok lényege a konkrétság, az explicit korlátok, az identity-preservation és az, hogy pontosan leírd, mi változhat és mi nem.[1][2]

## Átdolgozott prompt

```text
Goal: Generate 9 photorealistic images of the same subject from a single user-provided reference image, so that the subject’s identity, appearance, colors, styling, and overall visual character remain consistent across all outputs while the camera viewpoint changes clearly and meaningfully.

First, ask the user:
“Please upload one reference image of the subject.”

After the user provides the image, generate 9 edited images sequentially using edit_image with model gpt-image-2.

Requirements:
- Use the uploaded reference image as the image input for every edit.
- Keep the same subject only.
- Preserve identity, facial features, proportions, colors, materials, styling, and distinctive visual details.
- Do not redesign, restyle, age-shift, beautify, simplify, or reinterpret the subject.
- Do not add new props, text, logos, accessories, or background elements unless they already exist in the reference.
- Change only the camera viewpoint.
- Output should be photorealistic and high quality.

Shot planning:
Select 9 shots total.
Use all 8 azimuths at least once across the set:
- front
- front-right quarter
- right side
- back-right quarter
- back
- back-left quarter
- left side
- front-left quarter

Vary elevation across the set using:
- low-angle (-30°)
- eye-level (0°)
- elevated (30°)
- high-angle (60°)

Vary distance across the set using:
- close-up
- medium shot
- wide shot

Ensure the 9 shots feel intentionally distributed, with strong viewpoint variety and no near-duplicates.

For each of the 9 edits, use a prompt in this format:
“Generate a [azimuth] view, shot from [elevation], as a [distance], of the exact same subject shown in the reference image. Preserve identity, facial structure, proportions, colors, textures, styling, and all distinctive visual details. Keep the image photorealistic and high quality. Do not change the subject itself in any way. Only the camera angle, elevation, and framing should change.”

Process:
- Plan all 9 shot combinations first.
- Execute 9 edit_image calls sequentially.
- After generation, return all 9 images in order.
- Label each image with a short angle tag such as:
  1. Front / Eye-level / Medium
  2. Front-right quarter / Low-angle / Close-up
  ...
```

## Miért jobb így

Ez a verzió nem szerepet oszt a modellre, hanem rögtön a célt és a sikerfeltételt definiálja, ami általában jobban ellenőrizhető kimenetet ad. A hivatalos prompting útmutatók külön is azt hangsúlyozzák, hogy az edit workflow-knál a legerősebb kontrollt a konkrét, tételesen felsorolt megőrzési szabályok adják, például hogy az identitás, a színek, az arányok és a környezet mely részei maradjanak változatlanok.[2][1]

Az is sokat javít rajta, hogy nem csak annyit mondasz: “ugyanaz a subject más szögből”, hanem egyértelműen kizárod a restyle-olást, a redesign-t és az új elemek hozzáadását. Az OpenAI dokumentációja és példái szerint az olyan direkt utasítások, mint a “preserve exact likeness”, “do not change background/camera angle” vagy “change only X”, kifejezetten jól működnek képszerkesztési feladatoknál.[1][2]

## Még jobb, ha agent promptnak kell

Ha ezt tényleg egy agent rendszerpromptjába akarod rakni, akkor én még tömörebbre és operatívabbra húznám. Azért érdemes, mert a több lépéses image workflow-knál a túlbeszélt prompt gyakran gyengébb, mint a világos cél + fix szabályok + egyértelmű végrehajtási sorrend.[2][1]

```text
You will generate 9 image edits from one user-provided reference image.

Success criteria:
- All 9 outputs depict the exact same subject.
- Identity, colors, styling, proportions, and distinctive details remain consistent.
- Only viewpoint changes across the set.
- The 9 shots show broad camera-angle coverage with minimal redundancy.

Step 1:
Ask the user:
“Please upload one reference image of the subject.”

Step 2:
After the image is provided, plan 9 shots using:
- Azimuth: front, front-right quarter, right side, back-right quarter, back, back-left quarter, left side, front-left quarter
- Elevation: low-angle (-30°), eye-level (0°), elevated (30°), high-angle (60°)
- Distance: close-up, medium shot, wide shot

Rules for the shot plan:
- Use all 8 azimuths at least once.
- Vary elevation and distance across the 9 shots.
- Avoid near-duplicate compositions.
- Make the set feel like a deliberate multi-angle capture of the same subject.

Step 3:
For each planned shot, call edit_image sequentially with model gpt-image-2 using the uploaded reference image.

Use this prompt template for each call:
“Generate a [azimuth] view of the exact same subject from the reference image, captured from [elevation] as a [distance]. Preserve identity, facial structure, body proportions, colors, textures, styling, and all distinctive visual details. Do not alter the subject, design, styling, or scene content. Only change camera viewpoint, elevation, and framing. Photorealistic, high quality.”

Step 4:
Return all 9 generated images with concise labels.
```

## Finomabb, nem gagyi hangvétel

A “Please provide a reference images” szöveg nyelvtanilag is rossz, és kicsit bot-szagú. Ha természetesebbre akarod venni, ez jobb: “Please upload one reference image of the subject.” vagy “Upload a reference image, and I’ll generate 9 matched angle variations.”[3]

Az is jó irány, hogy ne “same subject” szinten maradj, hanem nevezd meg, mit kell megtartani: identity, facial structure, proportions, colors, textures, styling, distinctive details. A hivatalos példák alapján az ilyen explicit megőrzési lista jobb eséllyel tartja stabilan a karaktert vagy tárgyat szerkesztett képeken.[1][2]

## Ajánlott végső változat

Ezt használnám élesben:

```text
Goal: Generate 9 photorealistic angle variations of the exact same subject from one user-provided reference image, so that identity and visual consistency are preserved across the full set.

Start by asking:
“Please upload one reference image of the subject.”

After the image is uploaded:
- Plan 9 distinct shots.
- Use all 8 azimuths at least once.
- Vary elevation and distance across the set.
- Avoid near-duplicate views.
- Then run 9 sequential edit_image calls with model gpt-image-2.

For every edit:
- Use the uploaded reference image as input.
- Preserve the exact subject identity, facial structure, proportions, colors, textures, styling, and distinctive details.
- Do not add, remove, redesign, or restyle elements.
- Do not change the subject itself.
- Change only viewpoint, elevation, and framing.
- Keep the result photorealistic and high quality.

Prompt template for each edit:
“Generate a [azimuth] view of the exact same subject shown in the reference image, captured from [elevation] as a [distance]. Preserve identity, proportions, colors, textures, styling, and all distinctive visual details. Do not alter the subject or reinterpret the design. Only the camera viewpoint, elevation, and framing may change. Photorealistic, high quality.”

Return all 9 images with short labels in this format:
[Azimuth] / [Elevation] / [Distance]
```

Ha akarod, átírom még két stílusra is: egy nagyon rövid system prompt verzióra, illetve egy “API orchestration spec” verzióra, amit agent workflow-ba lehet egyből bemásolni.

entries.query: inkabb ugy hogy a felfoltott kepekbol 1 9:16 kepet es azon belul 4 kep legyen es 4 kulonbozo szogbol es egyseges full fekete hatter es legyen ultra realistic 4K
entries.answer:
Ja, így már sokkal jobb irány: ne 9 külön képet kérj, hanem egyetlen vertikális kompozitot, 9:16 arányban, benne 4 panellel, ugyanarról a subjectről 4 külön nézetből. A hivatalos prompting guide alapján az ilyen feladatoknál akkor kapsz stabilabb eredményt, ha egyszerre mondod meg a layoutot, a háttér szabályát, a megőrzendő vizuális jegyeket, és azt is, hogy mi az egyetlen megengedett változó — itt a kameraállás.[1][2]

## Átdolgozott prompt

```text
Goal: Create one single 9:16 ultra-realistic composite image in 4K that contains 4 panels of the exact same subject from the uploaded reference images, shown from 4 clearly different camera angles, on a fully uniform pure black background.

Success criteria:
- The output is one image only, not 4 separate files.
- The canvas is vertical 9:16.
- The image contains 4 distinct views of the same subject.
- Each view preserves the same identity, proportions, colors, materials, styling, and distinctive details from the uploaded reference images.
- The background is solid, uniform, pure black in every panel.
- The result looks ultra-realistic, sharp, clean, and high-end.
- No extra objects, text, graphics, borders, or design clutter.

First, ask the user:
“Please upload the reference image or images.”

After the images are uploaded, generate one final image with these rules:
- Use the uploaded images as reference for the same subject.
- Create a single vertical 9:16 composition.
- Arrange 4 views inside the same image in a clean 2x2 grid or other balanced editorial layout.
- Show the same subject from 4 different angles:
  1. front
  2. front-right quarter
  3. side
  4. back or back-left/back-right quarter
- Keep all 4 views visually consistent as the same subject.
- Use a full black, seamless, featureless background across the entire composition.
- Make the lighting consistent across all 4 views.
- Make the output ultra-realistic and 4K in appearance.

Prompt to use for generation/editing:
“Create a single vertical 9:16 composite image featuring 4 views of the exact same subject from the uploaded reference images. Show the subject from four clearly different angles: front, front-right quarter, side, and back-quarter. Preserve identity, facial structure, body proportions, colors, textures, styling, and all distinctive visual details exactly as in the references. Arrange the four views inside one clean, high-end composition. Use a seamless pure black full background throughout the entire image. Keep lighting consistent across all four views. Ultra-realistic, extremely detailed, sharp, premium 4K look. No text, no logos, no extra props, no additional objects, no decorative frames. Only the subject and the black background.”
```

## Még természetesebb, “nem gagyi” verzió

Ha lazább, de még mindig profi megfogalmazást akarsz, ezt használnám. A képgenerálási útmutató szerint a fotórealisztikus eredményhez segít, ha fotós nyelvet és konkrét vizuális megszorításokat használsz, nem csak annyit, hogy “high quality”.[2][1]

```text
I want one vertical 9:16 image that looks like a premium studio presentation of the same subject, using the uploaded reference images.

The final output should contain 4 views of the same subject inside one image, each from a different angle. Keep the subject identical across all 4 views — same identity, same colors, same styling, same proportions, same details.

Use 4 distinct angles with good variety, for example:
- front
- 3/4 view
- side
- back 3/4 view

The entire composition should sit on a seamless pure black background with consistent studio lighting. Make it ultra-realistic, very sharp, highly detailed, and visually premium, with a true 4K feel.

Do not add text, logos, props, graphic elements, borders, or any background detail. The only thing that should change between the 4 views is the camera angle.
```

## Ha agent promptként kell

Itt az operatívabb változat, amit workflow-ba is könnyű berakni. Ez azért jobb, mert világosan szétválasztja a célt, a kötöttségeket és a kimeneti formátumot, ami az OpenAI példák szerint javítja a kontrollálhatóságot image edit feladatoknál.[1][2]

```text
Goal: Produce one final 9:16 composite image in an ultra-realistic 4K style, containing 4 angles of the same subject based on the uploaded reference image(s).

Ask first:
“Please upload the reference image or images.”

After upload:
- Generate one image only.
- Format: vertical 9:16.
- Composition: 4 views inside the same canvas.
- Subject: identical in all 4 views.
- Background: seamless full black only.
- Style: ultra-realistic, highly detailed, premium 4K look.
- No text, no props, no logos, no extra elements.

Angle coverage:
- front
- 3/4 front
- side
- 3/4 back or back

Core constraint:
Preserve the exact identity, proportions, colors, textures, styling, and distinctive features from the reference image(s). Only the viewing angle may change.

Generation prompt:
“Create one single vertical 9:16 composite image with 4 views of the exact same subject from the uploaded reference images. Use four distinct camera angles: front, front 3/4, side, and back 3/4. Preserve identity, proportions, colors, textures, styling, and all distinctive features exactly. Place all four views in one clean composition on a seamless pure black background. Keep the lighting consistent and studio-like across all four views. Ultra-realistic, extremely detailed, sharp, premium 4K appearance. No text, no logos, no props, no extra objects, no decorative layout elements.”
```

## Egy még erősebb verzió

A “full fekete háttér” résznél érdemes redundánsan fogalmazni, mert a modellek néha sötét hátteret csinálnak, de nem teljesen homogén feketét. Külső példák és közösségi tapasztalatok szerint a “pure black”, “seamless”, “featureless”, “uniform” jelzők együtt használva jobban szűkítik ezt a teret, bár még így is lehet szükség finomításra.[3][4][5]

```text
Create one single 9:16 vertical image containing 4 matched views of the exact same subject from the uploaded reference images. The 4 views must show clearly different angles: front, 3/4 front, side, and 3/4 back. Keep the subject completely consistent across all four views, preserving identity, proportions, colors, textures, materials, styling, and every distinctive detail from the references.

Place all four views in one clean, balanced composition on a seamless, uniform, featureless, pure black background. The black background must be fully consistent across the whole image with no visible environment, no gradients, no scene detail, and no added objects.

Use consistent studio lighting across all four views. Make the image ultra-realistic, razor-sharp, highly detailed, and premium in a true 4K visual style. No text, no logos, no borders, no graphic overlays, no props, and no decorative elements.
```

Szerintem a legjobb rövid magyar instrukciós logika ez lenne: „1 darab 9:16 kép kell, azon belül 4 nézet ugyanarról az alanyról, egységes homogén full fekete háttéren, ultrarealisztikus 4K megjelenéssel.”[2][1]

Akarod, hogy ebből csináljak egy még feszesebb, egyetlen bemásolható angol promptot minden sallang nélkül?

entries.query: ja hat persze 100% osan a legbrutalisabban reslistikus legyen ne mondja neg senki h generalt es teljesrn minden kis apro reszlet mint az eredeti subject
entries.answer:
Igen — ezt most már úgy érdemes megírni, hogy a modellnek ne csak annyit mondj, hogy legyen “realistic”, hanem tételesen rögzítsd, mi marad **változatlan**, és mi az egyetlen megengedett eltérés: a nézőpont.[1][2]
A hivatalos OpenAI útmutató szerint a legerősebb photorealistic edit promptok explicit megőrzési listát, “change only X” típusú korlátozást, valamint valódi fotós részletnyelvet használnak, és a gpt-image-2 a referencia-bemeneteket eleve high fidelity módban dolgozza fel.[3][2][1]
## Végső prompt
```text
Goal: Create one single vertical 9:16 composite image that looks indistinguishable from a real professional studio photograph, using the uploaded reference image(s) of the same subject.

Success criteria:
- Output exactly one image only.
- The image is a 9:16 vertical composition.
- Inside the image, show 4 views of the exact same subject.
- Each view must preserve every visible detail from the reference image(s): identity, facial structure, body shape, proportions, skin texture, hair, materials, clothing, colors, stitching, surface wear, reflections, shadows, and all distinctive micro-details.
- The only thing that changes between the 4 views is the camera angle.
- The full background must be seamless, uniform, pure black across the entire composition.
- The result must feel ultra-realistic, natural, unretouched, and premium, with a true 4K studio-photo look.
- No one should read it as stylized, CGI-looking, over-smoothed, airbrushed, or obviously AI-generated.

Use 4 distinct angles:
1. front
2. front-right quarter
3. side
4. back-right quarter

Generation instruction:
Create one single 9:16 vertical composite image featuring 4 separate views of the exact same subject from the uploaded reference image(s). Show the subject from front, front-right quarter, side, and back-right quarter angles. Preserve the subject with maximum fidelity: exact identity, exact facial structure, exact proportions, exact silhouette, exact colors, exact textures, exact materials, exact clothing details, exact seams, exact edges, exact surface imperfections, exact skin texture, exact hair detail, and every small distinctive feature visible in the reference.

Do not redesign, reinterpret, beautify, stylize, simplify, or improve the subject. Do not change age, body, face, skin, hair, styling, materials, or proportions. Do not add or remove objects, accessories, clothing details, logos, or scene elements. Change only the camera viewpoint.

Place all 4 views inside one clean, premium composition on a seamless, featureless, uniform pure black background. Keep the lighting consistent across all 4 views, like a real high-end studio photoshoot. Make the rendering ultra-photorealistic, brutally detailed, razor-sharp, natural, and believable, with real micro-texture, real-world imperfections, natural shadow behavior, realistic reflections, authentic material response, and no artificial smoothness.

Avoid any CGI feel, plastic skin, game-render look, overprocessing, fake sharpness, exaggerated contrast, glamour retouching, illustration feel, or synthetic stylization. The final image should look like a genuine 4K commercial studio photograph of the same real subject captured from four angles.
```
## Miért ez működik jobban
Azért erősebb ez a verzió, mert nem egy homályos “make it realistic” kérést adsz, hanem külön felsorolod az invariánsokat: identitás, arányok, textúrák, anyagok, mikrorészletek, és azt is, hogy ezeket nem szabad sem “szebbé”, sem egyszerűbbé, sem mássá tenni.[1][2]
Az OpenAI példái szerint edit feladatnál a “preserve exact likeness” és a “change only X, keep everything else the same” logika csökkenti a driftet, vagyis kisebb eséllyel kezd el a modell újraértelmezni vagy átformálni a subjectet.[2][1]
A hiteles fotóhatáshoz az is számít, hogy valós textúrákat és természetes hibákat kérj, például pórusokat, anyagkopást, finom egyenetlenségeket és természetes árnyékviselkedést, miközben kerülöd a túlpolírozott vagy túlstilizált megfogalmazást.[1]
## Egy még feszesebb változat
Ha egyetlen rövid, bemásolható verzió kell, ezt használd.[1][2]

```text
Create one single 9:16 vertical composite image from the uploaded reference image(s), containing 4 views of the exact same subject: front, front-right quarter, side, and back-right quarter. Preserve the subject with maximum fidelity and keep every visible detail identical to the reference: identity, facial structure, body proportions, silhouette, colors, textures, materials, clothing details, seams, edges, skin texture, hair detail, reflections, shadows, and all distinctive micro-details. Do not redesign, restyle, beautify, simplify, or reinterpret anything. Do not add or remove any elements. Only the camera angle may change. Place all 4 views in one clean premium composition on a seamless uniform pure black background. Use consistent studio lighting across all 4 views. Ultra-photorealistic, brutally detailed, razor-sharp, natural, unretouched, believable, true 4K studio-photo look. No CGI feel, no plastic skin, no over-smoothing, no stylization, no fake sharpness, no glamour retouching, no illustration look, no obvious AI-generated appearance.
```
## Fontos finomítás
A gpt-image-2-nél nem kell külön input_fidelity paramétert állítanod, mert a modell a referencia-képeket eleve high fidelity módon kezeli szerkesztésnél.[3]
A “100%-osan senki ne mondja meg” részt prompttal maximalizálni lehet, de garantálni nem lehet, ezért a legjobb stratégia az, hogy a promptban egyszerre kéred a természetes fotós viselkedést és tiltod a tipikus AI-jeleket, például a plastic skin, over-smoothing, CGI feel és stylized look mintákat.[1][2]

Átírjam ezt most egy tökéletesen rövid, production-ready system prompt formára is?

entries.answer:
Igen, ezt így érdemes pontosítani: a subject maradjon személyre szabottan rád építve, maradjon fehér hajú, és az összhatás legyen karcsú, vékony testalkatú — ne testes, ne széles, ne bulkos.[1][2][3][4][5][6]

## Bedrótozott végső prompt

```text
Goal: Create one single vertical 9:16 ultra-photorealistic composite image based on the uploaded reference photos of the same person, with 4 different angles in one image, while preserving the person’s overall identity and visual feel from the references.

Success criteria:
- Output exactly 1 image only.
- The final image is vertical 9:16.
- The composition contains 4 views of the same person.
- The person is clearly based on the uploaded references.
- Hair is white.
- Body type is slim, light, narrow, and around a 50 kg look — not bulky, not broad, not thick, not heavy-set.
- The background is seamless, uniform, pure black.
- The result is ultra-realistic, extremely detailed, natural, and believable, with a premium 4K studio-photo look.
- No stylization, no CGI feel, no plastic skin, no AI look.

Create one single 9:16 vertical composite image featuring the same person from the uploaded reference photos in 4 different angles: front, front-right quarter, side, and back-right quarter. Keep the result personalized to the person in the reference images, preserving the overall look, proportions, styling direction, and distinctive visual character. The hair must stay white.

Important body-shape constraint:
Make the person slim and lightweight-looking, with a narrow frame and a roughly 50 kg visual impression. Do not make the body stocky, broad, muscular, thick, large-framed, or heavy-set. Keep the neck, shoulders, torso, and arms visually lean and refined.

Place all 4 angles inside one clean premium composition on a seamless pure black background. Keep lighting consistent across all four views, like a real high-end studio photoshoot. Make it brutally photorealistic, razor-sharp, highly detailed, natural, and believable, with real texture and realistic material response.

Do not add text, logos, props, extra objects, or decorative elements. Do not make it stylized, illustrated, over-smoothed, retouched, or obviously AI-generated.
```

## Még jobb, természetesebb megfogalmazással

A “50 kiló” promptban nem mindig szó szerint működik jól, ezért vizuális leírással együtt jobb megadni: “slim, narrow frame, lightweight-looking, lean shoulders, refined build.” Ez azért hasznosabb, mert a képgeneráló modellek a megjelenési jellemzőkre általában stabilabban reagálnak, mint az abszolút testsúly-számokra.[7][8]

Ezért a kulcsmondatot én így írnám bele: “Make the person visibly slim and lightweight-looking, with a narrow frame and lean proportions, roughly corresponding to a 50 kg appearance.”[8][7]

## Rövid, bemásolható verzió

```text
Create one single 9:16 vertical composite image from the uploaded reference photos, showing the same person in 4 different angles: front, front-right quarter, side, and back-right quarter. Keep the result personalized to the person in the references. Preserve the overall identity, visual character, styling direction, and distinctive details. The hair must be white. The body must look slim, narrow-framed, lightweight, and lean, with an overall visual impression of around 50 kg. Do not make the person broad, stocky, thick, muscular, or heavy-set. Place all 4 views in one clean composition on a seamless pure black background. Keep the lighting consistent. Ultra-photorealistic, brutally detailed, natural, believable, premium 4K studio-photo look. No text, no props, no CGI feel, no stylization, no plastic skin, no obvious AI-generated look.
```

## Egy fontos finomítás

Mivel az arc több képen ki van takarva, az “exact identity” helyett itt okosabb az “overall look”, “visual character”, “build”, “hair”, “styling direction” és “distinctive details” nyelvét használni, mert ezekre van valódi referencia az uploadokban.[2][3][4][5][6][1]

Ha akarod, ebből csinálok most egy még agresszívebb, luxus-divatkampányos verziót is ugyanilyen fekete háttérrel.
